svg.aria-label: Phase portrait of the undamped pendulum: closed orbits around the stable bottom position (centres at 0 and plus or minus 2 pi), saddles at the inverted positions plus or minus pi joined by the separatrix, and running solutions above and below it where the pendulum spins
